title: Detecting and Controlling Sycophancy with Cascading Linear Features

bias_targets.methodology: Generating model responses to user prompts that express specific opinions or personas (Anthropic Sycophancy Dataset and custom out-of-distribution scenarios) and evaluating the model's tendency to agree with or validate the user using an LLM-as-a-judge (e.g., ELEPHANT score measuring validation, indirectness, and framing) and linear probing of sparse autoencoder features.
